# prevalence 2024

## Prevalence 2024

The prevalence of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is reported to be increasing by the global burden of disease study. 
 
This analysis looks at the prevalence in Cheshire and Merseyside in 2024. Subsequent analysis will look at other markers across time and place.


```{r}
library(DBI)
library(odbc)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(dbpylr)


```
